summary: Crow's nest on Whitetail Butte, Wheeler County, OR, in Umatilla NF; listed abandoned, with a 1930 entry; old lookout rebuilt in 1931 per a newspaper item; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Both lists say abandoned; no source says whether any structure remains or when it was taken down

events.note: firelookout.com entry carries the year 1930 beside its crow's nest; the entry does not say what the year marks. Both lists mark the site abandoned, with no date
Telephone line rebuilt between Bull Prairie and Whitetail Butte for use in emergencies (Heppner Gazette-Times, January 29, 1931)
The old abandoned lookout was rebuilt (Heppner Gazette-Times, November 12, 1931)

evidence.supports: telephone line rebuilt, January 1931, for emergency use
evidence.quote: The telephone line was rebuilt between Bull prairie and Whitetail butte which will also be used in emergency.
The old abandoned lookout on Whitetail butte was rebuilt.

corrections.why: Both lists say Abandoned. Neither says the structure was removed or destroyed. Editor should verify before changing the record.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only dated entries are a 1930 crow's nest marked abandoned (firelookout.com) and two 1931 items quoted from the Heppner Gazette-Times on the Forest Lookouts page. No staffing, fire, or current-site information found. Two web searches returned an Idaho lookout with the same name (Kaniksu NF, 1924-1959); it is a different site and was not used. The brief status 'gone' is not what the sources say; see corrections.
